data.body_html:
May 2040 in Marbella offers near-perfect conditions for a yacht charter: warm days, calm seas, and plenty of sunshine. Whether you're planning a leisurely cruise from Puerto Banús or a full-day exploration to Estepona, this guide covers everything you need to know about the weather, sea conditions, and how to make the most of your charter. With average highs of 22°C and over 11 hours of sun daily, it's an ideal month for sailing, swimming, and sunbathing. Our fleet of over 15 boats, from the compact speedboat to the luxurious Ferretti 94, is ready for you. Let's dive into the details.

Average Temperatures in May 2040

In May 2040, Marbella enjoys average high temperatures of 22°C and lows of 16°C. This means comfortable conditions throughout the day, especially with the sea breeze. Early mornings and evenings can be cooler, so a light jacket is advisable for sunset charters. The water temperature sits around 18°C, which is refreshing for a quick dip but may not be for extended swimming without a wetsuit. For comparison, June sees highs of 26°C, so May is a milder alternative for those who prefer less heat.

Sunshine and Daylight Hours

May offers about 11 hours of sunshine per day, with sunrise around 7:15 AM and sunset near 9:15 PM. This gives you ample daylight for a full-day charter from 10 AM to 6 PM or a sunset cruise from 6 PM to 8 PM. The UV index is moderate to high, so bring sunscreen and a hat. The long days are perfect for multi-stop itineraries, such as cruising from Puerto Banús to Cala del Faro, then to Cabopino for lunch.

Sea Conditions and Wind

Sea conditions in May are generally calm, with westerly winds averaging 10-15 knots. This makes for smooth sailing on all our boats, from the agile Pershing 46 to the stable Mangusta 80. Swell heights are typically under 1 meter, ideal for beginner sailors and families. For the best experience, we recommend booking a morning or midday charter when winds are lightest. Our licensed skippers will navigate any weather changes, ensuring your safety and comfort.

Best Boats for May Weather

Given the mild conditions, most of our fleet is suitable. For groups up to 5, the Boat Rental Marbella speedboat or Dubhe are great for quick trips. For larger parties, the Azimut 58 Flybridge or Ferretti 94 offer spacious decks and sun protection. The Mangusta 80, at €4,719 for 4 hours, includes a free jet ski for added fun. All charters come with a skipper, fuel, drinks, and snacks, so you can relax and enjoy the May sun.

Pricing and Booking Tips for May

Our May rates start at €749 for a 2-hour charter on the Astondoa 40 or Azimut 39, covering up to 11 guests. An 8-hour day is €2,299. The Mangusta 80 requires a minimum 4-hour booking at €4,719. For other boats like the Canados 86 or Maiora 26m, pricing is available on request via WhatsApp. Given May's popularity for events like weddings and corporate outings, we advise booking at least 2-4 weeks in advance. Contact us via WhatsApp for availability and custom quotes.

What to Expect: Local Highlights

May is a vibrant month in Marbella. The Golden Mile and Puerto Banús are less crowded than summer, offering a relaxed vibe. You can anchor near Cala Cortés for swimming, or dock at Estepona for fresh seafood. The weather supports outdoor dining, so consider a lunch charter with our included snacks and drinks. For a full-day itinerary, cruise to Sotogrande for a mix of luxury and nature. The sea breeze keeps temperatures pleasant even at midday.

Packing Essentials for Your May Charter

Pack a swimsuit, sunscreen (SPF 50+), sunglasses, a hat, and a light jacket or windbreaker for evenings. Non-slip shoes are recommended for deck safety. If you plan to swim, a rash guard or wetsuit can make the 18°C water more comfortable. Our charters include water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, and cava, but you're welcome to bring your own snacks. Don't forget a camera for the stunning views of La Concha mountain and the Mediterranean coastline.
